meta.title: Traffic light on a buy event: at or below the lower bound is green, up to the upper bound yellow, above it red
gaps: No setup recipe creates a buy auction with traffic-light pricing and lower/upper bounds of 100 and 120.
Only vendor and vendor2 are available; the vocabulary has no third vendor.
No operation or read-back field exposes a vendor's traffic-light colour, so the mappings 100 → green, 120 → yellow, and 120.01 → red cannot be verified.
